privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how hao430.cn ("this site") collects, uses and protects visitor information. By accessing this site, you agree to the practices described in this policy.
privacy.sec1Body:
This site is a static personal website. It has no user accounts and no registration.
We do not actively collect personally identifiable information such as your name, email or phone number, unless you contact us directly by email.
When you visit, the server and content delivery network (CDN) may keep basic access logs (e.g. IP address, browser type, time of access) to ensure security and measure traffic.
privacy.sec3Body:
This site displays ads via Google AdSense. Google and its partners, as third-party vendors, may use cookies (such as the DoubleClick cookie) to serve ads on this site and across the web.
Google uses information about your visits to this and other sites to serve personalized ads. You can opt out of personalized advertising via Google Ads Settings (adssettings.google.com), or learn more at www.aboutads.info.
privacy.sec4Body:
We use collected information to improve site content and experience, measure traffic, keep the site secure, and sustain operations through advertising.
We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties.
privacy.sec5Body:
Under applicable law (including the EU GDPR and China's Personal Information Protection Law), you have the right to access, correct or delete personal information related to this site.
Since this site does not collect user account data, if you need to inquire about or delete any potentially stored information, please contact us via the details at the end of this page.
privacy.sec6Body: Articles on this site may link to third-party websites. We are not responsible for their privacy practices; we encourage you to review their privacy policies when you visit them.
privacy.sec7Body: This site is intended for the general public and is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.
privacy.sec8Body: We may update this policy from time to time. When we do, we will revise the "Last updated" date on this page. Material changes will be highlighted prominently on this site.
